# Model check

A **track** is one sequential line of work for one actor or station; steps within a track never overlap and anything that happens in parallel must go in a separate track. A **step** has exactly one duration type: `fixed` (a known number of seconds), `variable` (a range with min, max, and default), or `indefinite` (runs until someone manually stops it). A **startTrigger** anchors each step to the clock or to another step's completion—`programStart` (t=0), `programStartOffset` (delay from start), `afterStep` (when another step ends), `afterStepWithBuffer` (with a gap), `manual` (user taps to start), `onAbort` (only if a step is aborted), or `compound` (wait for all or any of several triggers). **stepIds must be unique across the entire program**, not just within one track. Every `task` that a step claims must have a matching `resourceConstraints` entry declaring its `maxConcurrent`—the number of steps using that task that can run at the same instant; this enforces that only one person can use the stage, only one projector can run, only two mics can be live at once, or only two FOH staff can usher simultaneously. Repeated work—n instances of the same step—is declared once with `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial"|"parallel"|"stagger"}` and never hand-copied; downstream steps chain per-instance with `instances: "each"` and collapse back to a single step with `instances: "all"`, and when a holding area (rack, rotor, booth queue) only fits k instances, `maxInFlight: k` holds the upstream step so downstream doesn't get stranded.

For this run-of-show, the resource constraints I expect are:

| task | maxConcurrent | notes |
|------|---|---|
| stage | 1 | only one event can happen on stage at a time (keynote, video, demo, Q&A, host close) |
| projector | 1 | only one presentation or video can display |
| pa_system | 1 | only one speaker/moderator can hold the microphone and audience attention |
| av_technician | 1 | one person running the booth (line check, deck, video playback) |
| producer | 1 | one person calling the show |
| foh_staff | 2 | two front-of-house staff (registration, walkthrough, ushering, breakdown) |
| catering | 1 | caterers circulating and resetting (bar/canapés setup, circulation) |

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "stage", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "projector", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "pa_system", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "av_technician", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "producer", "maxConcurrent": 1 },
    { "task": "foh_staff", "maxConcurrent": 2 },
    { "task": "catering", "maxConcurrent": 1 }
  ],
  "actors": 5,
  "note": "five core crew: producer, AV technician, two FOH staff, caterers (team); 200 guests (not actors in the scheduling sense)"
}
```
